pizzeria.name: Pizzeria owner
pizzeria.voice: warm, impatient, older man, slight Turku accent in English

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Turku, 2027. Last month you were a software developer. Then came the redundancy talks, and thousands of jobs like yours went to AI.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The austerity package abolished unemployment benefits, earnings-related and basic alike. The only work left is the work robots cannot yet do on their own.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A traditional pizzeria on Linnankatu needs a courier, but first you need a work licence, and the only ones left are sold on the black market. You have 120 euros.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Buy a work licence on the black market under Auransilta.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Go to Pizzeria Linnanportti at Linnankatu 17.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deliver the pizza to Linnankatu 13a.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deliver the pizza to Aurakatu 1.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deliver the pizza to Läntinen Rantakatu 3.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deliver the pizza to Kaskenkatu 4a.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press A to buy a work licence for 80 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press E to buy a work licence for 80 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press A to take the pizza.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press E to take the pizza.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press A to hand over the pizza.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press E to hand over the pizza.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press A to buy a bicycle for 60 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press E to buy a bicycle for 60 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press A to buy a car for 350 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press E to buy a car for 350 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A work licence costs 80 €. You cannot afford it yet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A bicycle costs 60 €. Deliver more pizzas first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A car costs 350 €. Deliver more pizzas first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Buy the work licence first. The dealer can wait.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Deliveries count only on foot or with your own vehicle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, no tip.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 1 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 2 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 3 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 4 €.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 5 €!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 6 €!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 7 €!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Paid 6 €, tip 8 €!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Too slow. The customer cancelled the order.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: A licence? Eighty euros. Don't ask whose it was.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: It's yours now. If the platform asks, you've been riding since 2024.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: Eighty, friend. Come back when you have it.

lines.speaker: market
lines.text: You already have one. We never met, remember?

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: So you're the new courier? Good. Hot pizza, fast legs, no excuses.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: No licence, no deliveries. The platform checks everything now.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Back already? Good, the next one is coming out of the oven.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Cancelled? The robots never get cancelled. Take the next one.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Linnankatu 13a, just up the street. Go, before the cheese sets!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Aurakatu 1, by the bridge. Don't stop to look at the river.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Läntinen Rantakatu 3, all the way down the river. Move it!

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Kaskenkatu 4a, across the river and up the hill. That's a long one.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Wheels! Bicycles, cars, everything runs. Mostly.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One bicycle, barely ridden. It's waiting for you right by the kerb.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Three hundred and fifty, and she's yours. The keys are in it.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Sixty for the bicycle, three-fifty for the car. Cash only, friend.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: No work licence? Then what do you need wheels for? Come back with one.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: You've got the best I have. Come back when I start selling robotaxis.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Already? It's still steaming. Keep the change!

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks. Right on time, more or less.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Finally. It's barely warm, you know.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That was quick! The app said twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thanks, just put it on the step.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: The drone next door gets here faster than you.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Wow, a human courier, and a fast one. Here, take something extra.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Good, I was just about to give up on dinner.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Did you walk here from Helsinki?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Up the whole hill already? You deserve a tip.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Long climb, huh? Thanks anyway.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Cold pizza on a cold evening. Lovely.
